title: Compare European bank zero field four in battle Item menu
changes: Add an optional bank-zero field-4 assertion to the recorded-scene differential harness.
validation: An isolated Windows build and one Wine raw-versus-e99 comparison passed all 340 recorded frames, including complete state, clock, video, OAM, dispatch and five audio outputs; 32 typed field-4 bytes were observed and protected inputs were unchanged.
limitations: Both arms shared the native cache; Linux, USA and native Windows remain unverified. No performance measurements.
